class.name: LensFlareEffect
class.brief_description: The sun's light bouncing inside the camera's lens.
class.description: A glare round the sun and colored ghosts along the line from it through the screen's center, with a faint halo, as the sun's light bouncing inside a camera's lens makes. The sun is the brightest [DirectionalLight3D] lighting the scene. The flare fades as the sun goes behind something or leaves the screen. Add it to a [Compositor]'s [member Compositor.compositor_effects], on a [WorldEnvironment] or [Camera3D]. It's drawn after the scene's see-through objects, before tonemapping, in each view (both eyes in VR), with the Forward+ renderer; with the others it draws nothing.
